title: Detailed bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Outer tub shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='44' ry='24' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <!-- Tub rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='44' ry='22' fill='#cce4ff'/>
  <!-- Inner tub basin -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='37' ry='17' fill='#a8d0f0'/>
  <!-- Water surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='34' ry='14' fill='#4fc3f7'/>
  <!-- Water highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='10' ry='4' fill='#81d4fa' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Water ripple 1 -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='56' rx='8' ry='3' fill='none' stroke='#b3e5fc' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Water ripple 2 -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='58' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='none' stroke='#b3e5fc' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Left tap -->
  <rect x='14' y='36' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='13' y='33' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#cfd8dc'/>

  <!-- Right tap -->
  <rect x='80' y='36' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='79' y='33' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#cfd8dc'/>

  <!-- Center faucet -->
  <rect x='48' y='28' width='4' height='22' rx='2' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='44' y='26' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='7' ry='2' fill='#cfd8dc'/>
  <!-- Faucet spout -->
  <rect x='49' y='48' width='2' height='5' rx='1' fill='#cfd8dc'/>

  <!-- Water stream from faucet -->
  <rect x='49' y='53' width='2' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4fc3f7' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Bubbles -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='48' r='4' fill='none' stroke='#b3e5fc' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='none' stroke='#b3e5fc' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='43' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Tub feet -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='83' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ffca28'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='83' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ffca28'/>

  <!-- Tub body highlight -->
  <path d='M22 62 Q50 78 78 62' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Rubber duck on water -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='52' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='47' r='3.5' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <circle cx='66.5' cy='46.5' r='0.8' fill='#333'/>
  <path d='M71 47 L74 48 L71 49 Z' fill='#ff9800'/>
  <!-- Duck wing -->
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#fdd835'/>
</svg>
